name: Asparagus Orange Chicken Salad

items: 2 cups cooked quinoa or 8 cups greens
1 large ripe, but firm avocado, thinly sliced
1 tsp freshly grated blood orange zest
½ cup raw almonds, roughly chopped
2 Tbsp avocado or another flavorless oil
Pinch garlic powder or minced garlic

steps.title: Salad ingredients
steps.body: For the salad: **1 lb fresh asparagus**, **2 cups cooked quinoa** or **8 cups greens**, **2 medium blood oranges**, **1 large ripe, but firm avocado**, thinly sliced, **1 cup cooked chicken**, **1 tsp freshly grated blood orange zest** and **½ cup raw almonds**, roughly chopped.

steps.title: Dressing ingredients
steps.body: For the ginger miso dressing: **2 Tbsp lime juice**, **2 Tbsp avocado or another flavorless oil**, **1 Tbsp fresh ginger**, grated, **1 Tbsp light miso**, **1 Tbsp pure maple syrup** and a pinch of garlic powder or minced garlic.

yields: Serves about 4 as a side, 2 as a main (estimated)
